source: v98 allowed receive teacher through strike-phase gate, yet it produced torque for only 1-3 post-contact frames while capture context persisted 10-30 frames. The separate strike-lease stance-readiness gate blocks receive teacher at the ball 0.2 m from foot, below teacher distance bound.
hypothesis: Bypassing strike stance readiness only during a measured post-receive capture window allows continuous bounded receive teacher torque and may retain the ball long enough for a true second foot shot.
paired_parent: v98 corresponding hold length, same consumed scenes; not Fresh
authority_gate: 3/3 receiver foot contacts, capture context active and at least 5 subsequent capture frames with nonzero contact teacher torque; zero motor/option overrides and no safety bypass.
positive_sample_gate: Authority gate plus 3/3 six-G1 safe clean foot transfers, no early nonfoot ball contact, no robot collision, and at least 2/3 later receiver foot shots >=0.20 s after first touch with outgoing speed >=2.0 m/s. Privileged teacher data cannot be directly promoted.
interpretation: Tests narrow control-plane authority and physical teacher reachability on consumed scenes only.
